fixture.v1WireAdjustment: The 48 deterministic missing-link targets are rebound to fixture card 1 because the existing v1 snapshot decoder requires every link target to be present in the same response. No production data is used.

methodology.command: npx playwright test --grep '10k history remains viewport-bounded' --repeat-each=3
methodology.outlierPolicy: No sample is removed. Median and nearest-rank p95 are retained.
methodology.timingPolicy: Browser timings are observational and are not an absolute wall-clock CI gate.
methodology.memoryPolicy: performance.memory is browser-specific, GC-sensitive, and coarse in this configuration; raw observations are retained but are not a CI gate.
methodology.requiredMechanismGate: Mounted history rows must be no greater than ceil(viewportHeight / 120) + one partial row + two times the fixed 4-row overscan.

verifiedInteractions: current item is restored and visible at the 10,000-card midpoint
scrolling reaches the final item while remaining within the mounted-row limit
Home and End move focus across unmounted ranges
Enter opens a virtualized card and browser Back restores history
prefix 99 exposes the same 111 explicit link candidates
desktop and Pixel 7 projects both pass

connectionsBoundary.decisionRequired: Whether connections should render all 10,000 cards or progressively disclose the current neighborhood/search results remains unresolved. This benchmark does not activate the full graph.
